Graphically it works well with mid, and upper middle settings. Never stuters while in gameplay, however many enemies it has to load.

Game wise, this game is fairly grindy, I would describe it as a mostly solo mmorpg kind of game loop. In the game you will be expected to decide your own destination, while following the basic progresion.

That is to say the game can, and should be, played as a group dungeon mmo. Only that the best descriptor of its day to day game loop is a solo mmo experiance. Grinding levels, farming for loot, gathering rare items.

This game is just a very flashy, action mmo rpg. Which is very good.

The game isnt pay to win. As a matter of fact the whole experiance can easily be played witout paying a dime. On top of this, all of the premium items and colectibles can also be bought witout spending any money. You can trade with other players for the rare items you farmed, and receive platinum (premium curency) in return.

The game is vast and i would recomend taking it slowly, but also watching a video guide if you're compleatly new. Otherwise you'll get overwhelmed and quit this very well polished game. The video guide i would recomend is IFlynn waframe ultimate beginer guide.

Other than watching video guides you can also ask for help in tutorial chat in game. There isnt a better and more welcoming community than Warframe community.
